title: Solubility-coverage scan across frozen REDOCK-003 crystallographic seeds
scientific_question: Which, if any, of the 15 frozen REDOCK-003 crystallographic ligands has AqSolDB structural coverage at or above the pre-existing 0.4 Morgan/Tanimoto boundary and is therefore eligible to seed a new Molecular Discovery program?

rcsb_source.note: The first successful program result will freeze the scientific projection hash of the retrieved chemical identities.

selection_rule.boundary_provenance: pre-existing ONLINE-EXP-002 descriptive similarity bin boundary
selection_rule.selection_among_eligible: highest nearest similarity, then case_id ascending
selection_rule.if_none_eligible: close MOLDISC-003 without selecting a seed

interpretation_boundaries: Seed selection is based on measured-solubility structural coverage, not predicted efficacy or binding.
RCSB crystallographic presence establishes structural provenance, not therapeutic value.
AqSolDB similarity does not imply equal solubility or shared biological mechanism.
MOLDISC-003 performs no model fitting, molecule generation or docking.
A selected seed only becomes eligible for a separately frozen next program; it is not declared a superior drug candidate.
